compression_level.description: Compression level from 0 (no compression) to 11 (zopfli, best ratio). Default is 6.

threads.description: Number of compression threads. -1 uses auto-detection of available processors. 1 disables threading.

block_size.description: Compression block size with suffix (e.g., '128K', '1M'). Default is 128K.

no_name.description: If true, do not store file name or modification time in the header.

keep.description: If true, do not delete the original file after compression.

force.description: If true, force overwrite of existing files and compress to terminal.

suffix.description: Custom output suffix (e.g., '.zz'). Empty string uses the default for the selected format.

stdout.description: If true, write output to stdout instead of a file.

independent.description: If true, compress blocks independently (no preset dictionary from previous block).

rsyncable.description: If true, use rsyncable compression to place block boundaries for efficient rsyncing.

comment.description: Text comment to include in the gzip/zip header. Empty for none.
